_about: Public-domain Robert Lewis Dabney (1820-1898, Southern Presbyterian theologian, Union Seminary in Virginia, later Texas) for the Word Hoard: his Systematic Theology (the Syllabus and Notes, 1878), Sacred Rhetoric, the Sensualistic Philosophy, Christ Our Penal Substitute, the Christian Sabbath, and the four volumes of Discussions (ed. C. R. Vaughan), raw Internet Archive OCR. CCEL holds none of it. Dabney was an open defender of slavery and of white supremacy after the war; his Defence of Virginia and his political tracts are listed under _excluded, not shelved, and the whole shelf awaits Adam's veto. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 5 (my pick). No uids minted.
